reason: Checks the response's header fields as Firefox received them: repeated names, and values with commas, in order. Strider's response headers are Effect Headers, one value per name, so repeated fields (Set-Cookie, WWW-Authenticate, X-Repeat) and their order can't be read back; the matrix row says headersArray is has, but its note is the one thing that doesn't hold. FF-008 also reads response.finished(), which Strider has no form of
